performance_effect.before: Every cadence-gated rendered frame opened a SYNCHRONIZE handle to host.hostPid, polled it, then closed it.
performance_effect.after: One SYNCHRONIZE handle is reused while host PID is stable; PID change, host exit/unusable handle, invalid host state or game Reset releases the cache.
